LanguageData.LP_DevourBrain.label: brain devouring
LanguageData.LP_DevourBrain.description: Bore tentacles into the skull of a downed creature (or a fresh humanlike corpse dead no more than 6 hours) and suck out its brain. The target dies at once (brain missing), and the mind flayer gains brain matter and absorbs 20% of the XP of the target's highest skill. Witnesses are deeply shaken, and the target's faction goodwill -15. Liches and necromantic constructs have no living brain; devouring them fails and leaves a 6-hour "taste of undeath". Mechanoids and the psychically deaf can't be devoured.
LanguageData.LP_MindBlast.label: psychic scream
LanguageData.LP_MindBlast.description: Release a psychic jolt in a cone ahead (9 cells). Hostile targets are stunned for about 4 seconds (scaled by their psychic sensitivity) and suffer 1 hour of "psychic concussion" (consciousness -20%). Mind resistance can resist it; mechanoids and the psychically deaf are unaffected. Costs 10 brain matter, cooldown 1 day.
